comparison.objective: Load a blank against fixture stops and secure it with an eccentric cam; candidate commissions an adjustable damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Workpiece registration and passive cam closure versus recessed-key unlocking, counterholding, fine adjustment, relocking, and guarded impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Blank remains registered after release versus two safe dynamic stops with stroke, rebound, overload, and drift constraints.
comparison.reason: Cam clamping tests fixture loading and retention, not calibrated response tuning. Record has no specs; the body omits clamp-force, position-tolerance, and damage thresholds.
